component: mbox empty scan callback status gap

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For an empty file, BeginScan queues OnStartScan and OnStopScan(NS_OK) on the main thread to avoid callbacks before return. It discards the OnStartScan result, while the nonempty path checks that result. Scoped test/API recommendation: explicitly test a rejected start callback on an empty mbox and decide whether the same abort/status contract must apply. This is a static branch difference, not a reproduced loss or a claim about the distinct empty batch-compaction contract.
